name: Jude – Job Board & Careers Page for JobAdder
author: debutstudio

sections.description:
Jude connects JobAdder to WordPress. Your JobAdder job ads appear on your own website as a job board or careers page, in your theme’s style, and stay in sync on their own. New jobs go up, changed jobs update and filled jobs come down, with nothing to copy and paste.

It’s built for recruitment agencies and in-house hiring teams that use the JobAdder ATS and want their vacancies on their own site, not only on job boards. No JobAdder? It works as a standalone WordPress job board too: add jobs by hand and they look and work the same. Jude is built by DEBUT Studio, a WordPress studio in Newcastle, UK.

How the JobAdder integration works

  1. Connect your JobAdder account in a couple of clicks (secure OAuth sign-in, no API keys to copy).
  2. Pick the JobAdder job board that feeds your website.
  3. Add the [jude_jobs] shortcode, the Jobs block or the Elementor widget to a page.

Your JobAdder jobs import on a schedule you choose, with categories, locations, job types, salaries, closing dates and client details. Client logos and job description documents (PDF, Word or images) come across from JobAdder too.

Free features

  • JobAdder job import on a schedule, or added by hand in WordPress
  • Job search and filters: keyword, location, category, job type and salary range, in a sidebar or a bar above the jobs
  • Search bar above the jobs with keyword, location and a Find jobs button
  • Three layouts: a grid of cards, a list with images and summaries, or simple rows
  • Client logos from JobAdder, or upload your own
  • Featured jobs from a “Featured” field on your JobAdder job board, shown first with a label
  • Saved jobs: candidates save jobs with a heart and see them together, no account needed
  • Closing soon labels, closing dates and interview dates
  • Job description downloads from JobAdder’s Documents tab
  • Apply on JobAdder, by email or at any link you set per job
  • Matches your theme: colours, corners, fonts, and every word on the page can be changed
  • Block editor blocks and an Elementor widget
  • Closed jobs show a friendly page, redirect to your jobs page, or return a 404
  • Sample jobs: one click fills your board with realistic jobs, photos and client logos to see how it looks, and one click removes them
  • Health check that emails you if the JobAdder connection drops or imports stop
  • Works with page caching plugins, clearing the cache when jobs change
  • Mobile friendly, with filters that slide out on phones
  • Theme templates and CSS variables for developers
  • Translation ready

Pro features

  • Apply form on your own site: CV upload, cover letter and consent, with applications sent straight into JobAdder and saved in WordPress. Show it under the job, in its own section, on its own page, as a slide-in or in a popup. Spam protection with Cloudflare Turnstile.
  • Job alerts: candidates sign up for new jobs by category, location and type, instantly, daily or weekly, with double opt-in and a Manage my preferences page. The sign-up box can use your accent colour to stand out
  • Real-time sync with JobAdder webhooks, so jobs change on your site the moment they change in JobAdder
  • Google for Jobs: JobPosting schema markup so your jobs can show in Google’s job search
  • Recruiter profiles with photo, job title, contact details, LinkedIn and bio
  • Field mapping for your JobAdder board’s own fields
  • Email notifications for recruiters and applicants
  • REST API for your jobs

Learn more at debut.studio.

Privacy

Jude stores its settings in WordPress options and jobs as a custom post type in your database. The free plugin does not collect or send visitor data. Saved jobs are kept in the visitor’s own browser.

External Services

This plugin can connect to two external services, and only when you choose to connect a JobAdder account: JobAdder (a recruitment platform) and the Debut Plugins connection relay (a small endpoint we operate so the JobAdder OAuth client secret is never shipped inside the plugin). Both are optional: the plugin works fully for jobs added by hand without them.

What the service does and why it is used

JobAdder hosts the canonical job and application data for many recruitment agencies. The plugin uses JobAdder’s REST API to:

  1. Authenticate the WordPress site with your JobAdder account using OAuth 2.0.
  2. Pull job advertisements from your JobAdder job board into WordPress, with each job’s client logo and job description documents.
  3. (Pro only) Receive webhook callbacks when jobs change in JobAdder, so listings stay in sync.
  4. (Pro only) Forward apply-form submissions and CVs back to JobAdder.

What data is sent and when

  • During OAuth connection: you are sent to JobAdder to authorise the connection. JobAdder returns an authorisation code to the Debut Plugins relay (https://debutplugins.com/jobadder-connect.php), which exchanges it for tokens using our server-side client secret and passes the resulting refresh token back to your site. No visitor data is sent.
  • During token refresh: your site sends its stored JobAdder refresh token to the Debut Plugins relay, which returns a fresh access token. This happens whenever the plugin needs to talk to JobAdder (for example before a scheduled import). No visitor data is sent.
  • During scheduled or manual import: authenticated GET requests are sent to JobAdder’s API base for jobs, client logos and job description documents. Your access token is sent as a Bearer header. No visitor data is sent.
  • (Pro) When an applicant submits the integrated apply form on a JobAdder-sourced job: the applicant’s name, email, phone, cover letter, and uploaded CV are POSTed to JobAdder’s /applications endpoint, then the CV is uploaded to /applications/{id}/resume.
  • (Pro) On site activation/connection: a webhook subscription is registered with JobAdder pointing back at this site (/wp-json/debut-jobs/v1/webhook). The site URL and site name are sent.
  • (Pro) On disconnection: a DELETE request removes the webhook subscription.
  • (Pro) When the apply form’s spam protection is turned on: the form loads Cloudflare Turnstile, and the visitor’s browser and the site send a check token to Cloudflare. See Cloudflare’s Privacy Policy and Turnstile terms.

No data is sent to JobAdder unless you explicitly connect a JobAdder account in the plugin’s Settings → Connection screen.

Service provider

JobAdder is provided by Job Adder Operations Pty Ltd.

  • JobAdder Terms of Service: https://jobadder.com/terms-and-conditions/
  • JobAdder Privacy Policy: https://jobadder.com/privacy-policy

Service provider: Debut Plugins connection relay

To avoid distributing our confidential JobAdder OAuth client secret inside the plugin, the OAuth token exchange is performed by a small relay endpoint we operate at https://debutplugins.com/jobadder-connect.php. Your site sends only the OAuth authorisation code (during connection) or your stored JobAdder refresh token (during refresh); the relay completes the exchange with JobAdder and returns the tokens to your site. The relay processes no visitor data and is contacted only while a JobAdder account is connected.

This relay is operated by Debut Studio Limited.

  • Terms of Service: https://debut.studio/plugin-terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://debut.studio/plugin-privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install from the WordPress plugin directory (Plugins → Add New, search “Jude JobAdder”), or upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin. The setup screen walks you through the rest.
  3. To use JobAdder, go to Jude → Settings → Connection and connect your JobAdder account.
  4. Add the [jude_jobs] shortcode, the Jobs block or the Elementor widget to a page.
sections.faq:
Do I need JobAdder to use this plugin?

No. Jude works as a standalone job board: add jobs in WordPress and they look and work the same. JobAdder is optional.

Which JobAdder jobs show on my site?

The jobs posted to the JobAdder job board you choose for your website. Post a job ad to that board in JobAdder and it appears on your site at the next import, or straight away with Pro’s real-time sync.

How often do jobs sync from JobAdder?

As often as you choose, from every 15 minutes to daily. With Pro, JobAdder tells your site the moment a job changes. You can also import by hand at any time.

How do candidates apply?

In the free plugin, each job links to JobAdder’s apply page, an email address or any link you set. Pro adds an apply form on your own site with CV upload that sends applications straight into JobAdder.

Can I feature jobs?

Yes. Ask JobAdder support to add a “Featured” checkbox field to your website job board, tick it on a job ad, and the job shows first with a Featured label. JobAdder’s Hot job tick works too.

Will my jobs show in Google for Jobs?

Pro adds JobPosting schema markup to every job page, which is what Google uses for its job search.

Does it work with my theme, Elementor or the block editor?

Yes. It uses your theme’s fonts and colours by default, and has a block for the block editor and an Elementor widget. Developers can override the templates in their theme and style everything with CSS variables.

Can I change how it looks?

Yes. Go to Jude → Appearance for layouts, colours, corners, fonts, filters, the job page, the sidebar and every word on the page.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. Strings use the debut-jobs text domain.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Changed: DEBUT Jobs is now Jude. Same plugin and same settings: only the name, menu icon and look of the admin have changed
  • New: [jude_jobs], [jude_jobs_list] and [jude_jobs_alert] shortcodes. The original [debut_jobs] ones still work, so existing pages don’t need changing
  • Changed: wording now refers to the “Debut Studio Limited” job board by its name in JobAdder

1.1.5

  • Fixed (Pro): real-time sync is more reliable. The key JobAdder sends back is now part of the address rather than a query string, the webhook is registered again automatically when the site’s address changes, and calls turned away are shown in the Real-time sync list so problems are easy to spot

1.1.4

  • Fixed: the salary filter compares like with like. Hourly, daily, weekly and monthly rates count as a yearly figure (so a day rate isn’t treated as a tiny salary), while jobs still show the rate as advertised

1.1.3

  • New: sample jobs. Add a dozen realistic jobs with photos, client logos and a recruiter from the Setup screen, and remove them all again with one click
  • New (Pro): the job alerts sign-up box can be reversed (your accent colour with white text) so it stands out
  • Changed: Save job and Share on LinkedIn are stacked in one actions box on the job page
  • Fixed: job description downloads now work on https sites whose uploads address still starts with http
  • Fixed (Pro): “Check real-time sync” now also re-registers the webhook when JobAdder has an old or http address for the site
  • Improved: the salary comes from the job ad when it has one (with its own per hour, day or year), and the rate per falls back to the job’s work type

1.1.2

  • Changed: the plugin is now DEBUT Jobs for JobAdder, with a clearer description and FAQ

1.1.1

  • New: featured jobs, from a “Featured” checkbox field on your JobAdder job board (or its Hot job tick), with a label, shown first, and featured=”yes” for a featured jobs section
  • Changed: the plugin is now called DEBUT Jobs in the plugins list and the menu
  • Removed: the preview panel on the Appearance screen

1.1.0

  • New: rows layout (title on the left, tags on the right, Share and Apply on hover); tags drop under long titles
  • New: search bar above the jobs (keyword, location and button), or keyword search in the sidebar
  • New: client logos on job cards and the job page sidebar, pulled from JobAdder or uploaded in WordPress
  • New: filter lists collapse after five options with Show more, and filters slide out as a panel on phones
  • New: save jobs, with an All jobs / My saved jobs tab
  • New: job description documents from JobAdder (PDF, Word, PNG, JPG) shown as downloads on the job page
  • New: Closing soon labels, interview date, equal opportunities box and bolder headings on the job page
  • New: choose what closed job links do (a closed page, a redirect to the jobs page, or a 404)
  • New: Jobs blocks for the block editor and an Elementor widget
  • New: health check on the Import screen, with an email when the JobAdder connection drops or imports keep failing
  • New: export and import Appearance settings, a live preview, and every front-end word editable under Wording
  • New (Pro): job alerts with a sign-up popup, double opt-in, instant, daily or weekly emails and Manage my preferences
  • New (Pro): apply form under the job, in its own full-width section, on its own page, slide-in or popup; spam protection with Turnstile
  • Improved: imports skip unchanged jobs, clear page caches when jobs change, and branded emails throughout

1.0.7

  • Updated Freemius SDK to the latest version.

1.0.6

  • Updated based on WP directory submission review

1.0.5

  • Fixes as per WP directory

1.0.4

  • Updated main plugin file

1.0.6

  • Updated tested up to

1.0.3

  • Security: moved JobAdder OAuth client secret to a server-side relay; the plugin no longer ships secrets
  • Fixed: clicking Disconnect now correctly clears the JobAdder connection on hosts with aggressive object caching
  • Fixed (Pro): integrated apply form now correctly takes precedence over external email/URL on JobAdder jobs

1.0.2

  • Security: moved JobAdder OAuth client secret to a server-side relay; the plugin no longer ships secrets
  • Fixed: clicking Disconnect now correctly clears the JobAdder connection on hosts with aggressive object caching

1.0.1

  • Security: moved JobAdder OAuth client secret to a server-side relay so it’s no longer distributed in the plugin code.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
